model_name: sex-specific interpolated HDL moments with modest age pattern and positive stochastic residuals

assumptions.description: Conditional HDL location and individual variability from Taiwan are provisionally transported without a U.S. offset; population differences are model uncertainty and not extra per-person random noise.

BMI category representative locations are assumed as 17.5, 21.25, 25.5 and 30 kg/m2. The two closed intervals use their midpoints; open-bin representatives are assumptions. Linearly interpolate mean and SD between representatives; hold below 17.5.

SE*sqrt(n) is the approximate within-sex/BMI-cell SD. Use it as conditional SD, retaining omitted-factor heterogeneity; no claimed residual-variance decomposition. Endpoint SD is retained above BMI 30.

Use the adjusted age contrasts as a common additive pattern at ages 35,45,55.5,65.5, with constant endpoint extrapolation. Assume every sex/BMI cell has the overall source age mixing weights when centering. This does not establish age-sex or age-BMI independence in the target.

Above BMI 30, continue the mean downward exponentially toward 30 mg/dL in men and 38 mg/dL in women, at decay 0.04 per BMI unit. These are explicitly assumed extrapolation values, not measured biological asymptotes. Alternative flat continuation is tested.

Conditional HDL is lognormal matched to specified arithmetic mean and SD, chosen for positivity and right skew. Tail form and latent-factor mixtures are not identified by mean/SE evidence; independent local RNG draws represent residual individual variability only.

Treat reported HDL-C mg/dL as comparable to direct serum HDL with no estimated assay or fasting shift; this is a measurement bridge because assays/fasting differ or are incompletely reported. Continuous unrounded values are generated.

bmi_anchor_kg_m2.derivation: Closed BMI interval midpoints; assumed representatives for the two open categories. No source BMI means were reported.

mean_hdl_by_sex.derivation: Exact Table 2 sex-row arithmetic means at assumed representative BMI points; no outcome fitting.

sd_hdl_by_sex.derivation: For each sex/BMI cell, reported SE multiplied by sqrt(reported n); preserve full computation precision. Rounded SE limits precision.

age_knots_years.derivation: Approximate age-category midpoints. Article age label 40-50 retained as an acknowledged ambiguity.

age_effect_mg_dl.derivation: Table 3 contrasts [0,0.75841,1.18484,0.87361] in mg/dL, not slopes per year.

age_center_mg_dl.derivation: sum(n_age * contrast)/sum(n_age), with n_age=[4112,4087,4141,2197]. This exact centering holds only under assumed source-category midpoint mixing.

tail_asymptote_by_sex.derivation: Assumed men 30 and women 38 mg/dL; not a fitted floor or individual HDL lower bound.

tail_decay_per_bmi.derivation: 0.04 is assumed, with e-fold distance 25 BMI units. Qualitative inverse/mostly linear source associations motivate allowing continued decline but do not estimate this value.

equations: m0(b,sex) is linear interpolation of Table 2 means at assumed BMI anchors.
s=linear interpolation of SE*sqrt(n) at the BMI anchors, constant beyond endpoints.
interpretation: Associational virtual data. Fixed selected parameters do not quantify epistemic uncertainty. Source population differences are not individual residual noise.
unsupported_exact_operators: Taiwan published cell means after integrating over actual within-cell BMI and age: unavailable joint distributions.
Dallas marginal quantiles: missing source BMI/age/ethnicity joint distribution.
UK/Malawi numerical slope: unsupported PDF supplement.
